text:
Logan Cooley has two hat tricks a week apart. The second one, at Montreal on Thursday, came in an overtime loss and was the fifth of his career, which FOX 13 Utah called NHL history. He has 11 goals in his last ten games and 21 points in 17 overall.

Two things are true at once. The breakout is real: he is up to 18:23 a night, on the ice for 80% of Utah's power-play chances (up from 61%), and generating more chances than ever. His speed is among the league's best (99th percentile in top speed and bursts). Our form verdict calls the hot streak earned.

And the finishing is not. He is shooting 37.9% on 29 shots against a likely range of 15.5 to 21.2, with 11 goals on 6.0 expected. Fourteen of his 21 points have come on the power play. Expect the goals to come back to earth while the role stays. Even then our projection sits near 34 goals, well beyond the 24 he scored in 54 games last season.
headline: Cooley is scoring at a pace that cannot last
